items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I had my own firm going in partnership with a fellow named Frank Garisto

ctx.x: Can you rattle off a few of the commercials you remember doing, specific things?
Well it was so long ago that some of them are now illicit. For example we used to do cigarette ads. I can’t remember them now. Too many products. When I was working with © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

Herman and then after that for a year or so I had my own firm going in partnership with a fellow named Frank Garisto, and we would do one or two of these a week. It was fairly good money and it was kind of interesting and as I say the strain was in dealing with the client and not in producing the music.
